title: Bounded-K all-showdown critic targets
question: Does applying deterministic K=200 runout-averaged line-value targets to every eligible non-fold showdown critic row reduce target variance and improve or preserve the learned critic without policy, throughput, entropy, or mirrored-play regression?

authority.source: standing V5 campaign authorization recorded by event v5-user-standing-l5-campaign-authorization-20260713

source.selection_rule: H1 FAIL selects the exact preregistered critic_v1 rollback checkpoint; no H1 endpoint may be substituted

single_variable.name: showdown_ev_value_target_scope
single_variable.control: existing sampled critic returns plus existing all-in-before-river reward EV
single_variable.treatment: replace critic returns only on eligible non-fold showdown rows with exact-or-K200 conditional line-value targets

treatment_contract.eligible_hand: terminal non-fold hand with both hole cards revealed
treatment_contract.eligible_rows: each trainable decision row on an eligible hand whose row board has fewer than five cards
treatment_contract.estimand: terminal net line profit in existing BB units conditional on revealed holes, row board, and final committed-chip vector
treatment_contract.runouts: exact enumeration when unique completions <=200; otherwise 200 deterministic unique completions
treatment_contract.sampling_key: fixed deal identity plus row board; common unique runouts are reused across seats and repeated same-board decisions within the hand
treatment_contract.evaluator: vectorized exact seven-card rank evaluator validated against treys over 2000 random hands
treatment_contract.forbidden_interpretation: does not estimate unchosen action EV and cannot authorize action-specific tuning

endpoint_critic_mse.comparison: treatment relative degradation versus control on identical rows

internal_mirror.fixed_panel: exact gate31400 active loss-kbest K5 snapshot identities in deterministic round-robin

throughput.metric: actual hands divided by full wall-clock between accepted metric rows

entropy.protocol_abort: treatment entropy below0.3 for20 consecutive accepted rows

required: exact source and endpoint iteration/hands/checkpoint SHA256
control/treatment configs equal except registered H2 treatment fields and identity/output paths
all registered rows and evidence bundles present
actor reward and GAE advantage code-path identity
no H2 holdout used for training

terminal_rule.protocol_abort: any identity/config/source mismatch, non-PASS frozen prerequisite, nonzero pretraining actor-logit delta, nonfinite loss/gradient, first60 h/s ratio<0.85, entropy<0.3 for20 rows, or missing provenance
terminal_rule.pass: every offline variance/bias, endpoint-MSE, 40k-pair mirror, first60/full throughput, entropy, health, provenance and identity gate passes
terminal_rule.fail: a complete valid fixed window has variance CI upper<0.20, mean-bias guard failure, endpoint-MSE guard failure, mirror CI upper<-20, full-window h/s<0.85, or terminal entropy failure
terminal_rule.inconclusive: a complete valid fixed sample is neither PASS nor FAIL under the frozen rules

rollback_and_next.on_pass: adopt H2 treatment endpoint only for separately preregistered downstream H3 preparation
rollback_and_next.on_fail_or_inconclusive: do not adopt H2; restore exact gate31400 critic_v1 source/control contract
rollback_and_next.route_review: H1 is one terminal FAIL/no-progress window; a terminal H2 FAIL/no-progress is the second consecutive and triggers an autonomous registered route review before the next behavior window
rollback_and_next.official_slumbot: zero H2 hands; no V4/L5/L6 inference
